name: Wakugin Shizukuno
source:
A fluffy, fairy-like idol. She is graceful and refined. She has an honest personality, and shows kindness towards everyone. Her outfit is less revealing than the other members, to give the impression of being someone out of reach!
[Translated from [url=https://cream-nohana.fanbox.cc/posts/8667943]Fanbox[/url]]
